description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two different text-to-SQL generation systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four varying levels of query complexity: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis represents the query complexity, while the vertical axis indicates the execution accuracy, measured in percentage. For Simple queries, NatSQL has an accuracy of 60.21%, while TA-SQL has a slightly higher accuracy of 63.14%. In Moderate complexity queries, NatSQL's accuracy is 39.64%, and TA-SQL's accuracy is 48.60%. Challenging queries show NatSQL with an accuracy of 32.32% and TA-SQL with 36.11%. The Total accuracy combines the results from all complexity levels, with NatSQL at 51.35% and TA-SQL at 56.19%. The bars are color-coded, with NatSQL represented in a lighter shade and TA-SQL in a darker shade. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
